geometry_source: Harvard CHGIS Japan Historical GIS, Tokugawa Japan GIS 2004 (jp_toku_kuni_pgn.shp, DOI 10.7910/DVN/2CVTR0) compared with artifacts/data/population_capacity/location_geometry_calibrated.parquet and the EU5 historical-province selectors.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Satsuma no kuni polygon in CHGIS; stable medieval province name and outline used as a documented approximation to the 1280 register boundary.
crosswalks.resolution_method: The EU5 Satsuma selector was checked against the CHGIS historical-province layer and calibrated location centroids. All four selected EU5 locations belong to the historical province; 0.95 is retained as a conservative footprint coverage contract because the CHGIS administrative polygon is a later documented approximation to the 1280 boundary and EU5 locations are coarse polygons.
crosswalks.notes: No population or yield is imputed to omitted areas; the one-sided floor is tested on the explicitly selected footprint.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Ōsumi no kuni polygon in CHGIS; documented approximation to the 1280 register boundary.
crosswalks.resolution_method: All seven EU5 Ōsumi locations are assigned to the corresponding CHGIS province polygon by historical-province selector and calibrated centroid check. The declared 0.95 coverage is conservative for coarse location footprints and the later polygon date.
crosswalks.notes: This is a lower-bound crosswalk, not an assertion of a complete medieval cadastral match.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Hyūga no kuni polygon in CHGIS; documented approximation to the 1280 register boundary.
crosswalks.resolution_method: The eight EU5 Hyūga locations are contained by the CHGIS historical-province selector under the calibrated centroid check. A 0.95 coverage contract retains uncertainty from the 1828 polygon approximation and coarse EU5 location footprints.
crosswalks.notes: No non-rice or import-based population is added during mapping.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Bungo no kuni polygon in CHGIS; documented approximation to the 1280 register boundary.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Eight EU5 Bungo locations match the CHGIS province selector and calibrated historical-province centroid check. The 0.95 declaration is conservative for the documented date mismatch and footprint granularity.
crosswalks.notes: The registered rice floor is summed over these locations only.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Hizen no kuni polygon in CHGIS; documented approximation to the 1280 register boundary.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Eight EU5 Hizen locations match the CHGIS historical-province selector and calibrated centroid check. Coverage is conservatively set to 0.95 for later polygon date and coarse EU5 footprint geometry.
crosswalks.notes: No cities or imported food hubs are separated because the lower-bound test uses the entire province footprint and does not infer a complete population.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Tango no kuni polygon in CHGIS; documented approximation to the 1280 register boundary.
crosswalks.resolution_method: All three EU5 Tango locations map to the CHGIS historical-province polygon through the calibrated province selector. The 0.95 declaration accounts for coarse location footprints and the documented later boundary date.
crosswalks.notes: The value remains a rice-based floor only.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Tajima no kuni polygon in CHGIS; documented approximation to the 1280 register boundary.
crosswalks.resolution_method: The three EU5 Tajima locations are selected by matching the CHGIS historical-province polygon. Coverage is conservatively declared at 0.95 because the source polygon post-dates the register and EU5 locations are coarse.
crosswalks.notes: No adjustment is made for Japan Sea trade or non-rice foods.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Iwami no kuni polygon in CHGIS; documented approximation to the 1280 register boundary.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Five EU5 Iwami locations map to the CHGIS historical-province selector. The declared 0.95 coverage preserves uncertainty from the historical polygon date and coarse EU5 footprints; the paddy-omission warning is handled in the evidence packet as a one-sided floor.
crosswalks.notes: This mapping must not be used to infer the missing rice acreage or an upper capacity.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Hitachi no kuni polygon in CHGIS; documented approximation to the 1280 register boundary.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Seven EU5 Hitachi locations match the CHGIS historical-province selector and calibrated centroid check. Coverage is conservatively declared at 0.95 for coarse EU5 footprints and the later boundary approximation. Farris's possible shrine-paddy omission remains an explicit lower-bound caveat.
crosswalks.notes: No upward correction is made for omitted paddies.
